  test("rejects invalid config", () => {
    assert.throws(() => validateHookConfig({ command: 42 }), /invalid hook config/);
  });

  export function validateHookConfig(config: unknown): void {

      throw new Error("invalid hook config");
    }
  }

    assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateHookConfig({ command: "run" }));
